ecolongr

Source: AGENTS.md

R package: community-ecology analyses (a subset of vegan) on long tables without zeros, computed lazily with duckplyr. DESIGN.md holds the scope, the decisions and the open questions. Read it first.

Working rules

  • Test first. Write the failing testthat test, show it, then implement.
  • vegan is the reference: every result is compared with the vegan call it replaces, at tolerance 1e-10.
  • Each test must be able to fail on a plausible wrong implementation.
  • Functions use the prefix el_ and take a table with columns sample, taxon and quant.

duckplyr

  • Convert input with as_duckdb_tibble(x, prudence = "stingy"), so an untranslatable verb is an error and not a silent copy into R. as_duckdb_tibble() on a duckplyr_df resets the prudence.
  • Use .by =, not group_by().
  • Use na.rm = TRUE in sum() and mean() inside mutate(.by = ); without it duckplyr falls back.
  • Collect only where DESIGN.md says a function materializes.
  • Translatable: log, log10, abs, round, as.integer, arithmetic, comparisons, if_else, min, max, sum, mean. Not translatable: sqrt, exp, floor, ^, pmin, ifelse, cross_join. Use round(x) != x for “not a whole number”, a window min() in mutate() for a table-wide value, and read_sql_duckdb() after compute_parquet() where SQL is the only way.

Commands

  • devtools::test() runs the tests, devtools::document() regenerates man/ and NAMESPACE, devtools::check() runs R CMD check.
  • duckplyr::fallback_sitrep() shows the fallback logging settings. Never upload fallback reports.

Performance and memory

  • The kernel is src/kernel.cpp (Rcpp, OpenMP). Benchmark with an installed package: devtools::load_all() compiles with -O0 and is about 10 times slower.
  • bench/gen.R makes a skewed synthetic table and bench/run.R times el_vegdist() on it with peak memory.
  • Peak memory is the reason for the design: the result (one number per pair of samples), one batch, and DuckDB’s memory_limit. The query’s first step runs in the duckplyr connection, whose settings belong to the user’s session and must not be changed.
